scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "DB,API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,green,cyan" "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:api: wait-on tcp:51214 && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:ui: wait-on tcp:5000 && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
